title: Coast Guard rescues 4 from water after sailing vessel runs aground near St. Catherine's Sound
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Savannah MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew hoists four mariners March 16, 2020, after their sailing vessel took on water, became aground and capsized in St. Catherine's Sound, Georgia. All four mariners were taken to Hunter Army Airfield and transferred to EMS for further medical care. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Savannah)
